name: Integrity Tennessee
old_description: Integrity USA is a central US-based manufacturer of injector molds and CNC machining company backed by a global network. With the ISO 9001 certification, we ensure every project meets top-tier standards from prototypes to full-scale production.
about:
Integrity Tennessee operates from Pulaski, Tennessee, positioning itself as a central U.S. manufacturer of injection molds and CNC-machined components. The company serves customers across the United States, Canada, and Mexico, leveraging its geographic location to provide responsive tooling and machining services throughout North America.

The shop provides a full spectrum of mold-related services, including new mold construction, mold flow analysis and design, injection mold repair, and preventive maintenance programs. Its machining division delivers precision CNC milling and turning for complex parts, along with mold tooling, die making, and rapid prototyping. The company states it works with a broad range of metals, alloys, and plastics, supporting projects from prototype through full-scale production.

Integrity Tennessee targets global manufacturers requiring precision tooling and machined parts, offering a single-source model that covers design, manufacturing, and ongoing maintenance. Its customer base spans industries that rely on injection molding and high-accuracy machining, though specific sectors are not detailed in public materials.

The company emphasizes its ISO 9001 certification and a four-step process — connect, design, manufacture, maintain — as differentiators that reduce risk, save time, and guarantee quality. It promotes a “one partner” approach from initial concept to final part delivery, highlighting quick-turn prototyping and rapid repair services to minimize downtime.
